flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4103 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.
Get the booking reference code from the booking confirmation and save it as {{ref}}.

remark: click: Clicking Dismiss cookie notice button
click: Clicking Book free visit button
wait: queued plan (5 steps): type "Your name"; type "Email address"; type "Visit date"
click: Click "I accept the climbing waiver."
click: Clicking the noon arrival time selection control
click: Clicking Confirm my free visit
wait: PRIMARY: wait briefly with booking confirmation visible after accepted waiver
analyze: a reference code is shown
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown
analyze: the booking reference is stored as {{ref}}
analyze: the booking reference code is saved as {{ref}}
wait: Waiting booking confirmation remains visible with reference PL-4821

summary:
Booked a free first visit for Sam Rivera using sam@example.com on November 2, 2026, at noon.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed, with reference code PL-4821.
